node.statement: Define W to be the def-maincb-witness-ledger tuple (c0_cb,L,K_1,K_2,K_3,K_call,e_env,e_1,e_s2,e_cross,r_reset,epsilon_MAIN). By the definition, these entries are exactly its twelve named fields, so the remaining fields equal the correspondingly named receiving witnesses; combining their inherited properties with the established properties of K_call,r_reset,epsilon_MAIN proves existence of the asserted W and proves that every field is positive, finite, universal, and independent of dimension, amplification, block data, class count, and stage index.
